basic_profile.bio: TrailBlazerGamer is a 27-year-old avid gamer and outdoor enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. By day, they work as a software developer, primarily focusing on creating mods for popular video games. During their free time, they enjoy exploring hiking trails along the Pacific Crest Trail and sharing their adventures with the Local Guides community. Despite their love for gaming, they have a strong dislike for mainstream TV shows that depict outdated gender roles, as evidenced by their active participation in the FemaleDatingStrategy subreddit. Their online hours typically range from 8 PM to midnight, as they juggle work, gaming, and outdoor activities. Currently single, they find joy in their hobbies and the online communities they engage with.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: TrailBlazerGamer has a strong background in computer science, having completed a degree in the field a few years ago. They have honed their skills in software development through a combination of formal education and self-teaching, especially in creating mods for games like Red Dead Redemption. Their passion for hiking has also led them to gather practical knowledge about outdoor survival and trail navigation.
